_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Flutter Analysis Report
summary: The Flutter Analysis Report documents the air vehicle's aeroelastic and aeroservoelastic characteristics to substantiate that design requirements preventing such instabilities are met.
use_relationship:
The Flutter Analysis Report will be used to document the determination of the air vehicle aeroelastic and aeroservoelastic characteristics. The principal use is to substantiate that the air vehicle meets the design requirements for the prevention of aeroelastic and aeroservoelastic instabilities.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) is applicable to any contract where flutter analysis is required.
b. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.
c. DI-MISC-81390A supersedes DI-MISC-81390.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Flutter Analysis Report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: This report shall contain, when applicable, results of the following:

children.title: Flutter analyses of the air vehicle including control surfaces.
Component flutter analyses, other than control surfaces, which are exposed to the airstream.
Flutter analyses of the air vehicle with external stores.
Analyses results for both normal and design failure conditions shall be presented.
children.content: The methods used in the analyses shall be clearly described. The methods of representing the inertial and elastic characteristics (such as the finite element structural model used), as well as the methods of representing the aerodynamic forces and flight control augmentation system effects, shall be described in detail.

children.title: Representative plots of mode shapes and frequencies of the structural modes used in the flutter analyses.
Representative plots of damping coefficient, g, and variation in frequency of each mode versus air speed.
Plots or tables of flutter speed versus the variation in important parameters resulting from parametric studies.
Summary plots showing predicted flutter speed and air vehicle limit speed versus Mach number for various altitudes.
Root locus plots, Nyquist plots, or other suitable stability presentation forms for aeroservoelastic analysis results.
Where the approach to flutter substantiation involves supporting test effort
children.content: (model tests, ground vibration tests, flight control augmentation system ground tests, and other tests that have been completed), their interpretation and relation or correction to the analyses results shall be presented or included.
